summary: American Rebel Holdings filed an 8-K reporting an exchange agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC, converting a $93,000 partitioned note into 697,674 common shares at $0.1333, alongside various note conversions by 1800 Diagonal Lending and Silverback Capital into company stock, and a grant of 25,000 Series A preferred shares to COO Corey Lambrecht. The filing covers material agreements, unregistered sales, and officer compensation arrangements, but lacks special-situation elements like acquisitions or tender offers. It reflects routine capital structure adjustments and equity issuances. Watch for dilution impact and potential overhang from these conversions.
